summary.text: Tamara Lesnar of Grenville is the Libertarian nominee for South Dakota secretary of state. A former compliance officer at the Chicago Mercantile Exchange who now runs a small collectibles business, she ran for U.S. Senate in 2022 and the state House in 2024.
She supports continuing to use vote-tabulation machines and proposes online databases letting residents indicate preferences on issues before lawmakers vote.

paragraphs.text: Lesnar worked as a compliance officer at the Chicago Mercantile Exchange and now operates a small collectibles business in Grenville.
She was the Libertarian candidate for U.S. Senate in South Dakota in 2022, receiving 4% of the vote, and ran unsuccessfully for the South Dakota House in 2024.
The Libertarian Party of South Dakota nominated Lesnar for secretary of state, and her campaign says she promises to protect civil liberties and civil rights.

Her platform lists easier access to voting locations, curbing double taxation, a statewide database for ballot initiatives and signatures, and filing lawsuits against laws that violate the Bill of Rights.
